data: Do the graphs for text-to-text cumulative surprise and text-to-past cumulative surprise use the same scale for their y axes?

The graphs for text-to-text cumulative surprise and text-to-past cumulative surprise do not use the same scale for their y axes. The y-axis range for the text-to-text cumulative surprise graph extends from -600 to 0 bits, while the y-axis range for the text-to-past cumulative surprise graph extends from -200 to 0 bits.
